## Change

Describe the behavior and user-visible result.

## Safety and evidence

- [ ] The change keeps ordinary tests read-only, or uses central typed authorization.
- [ ] New collection fields and retained evidence are listed and privacy-reviewed.
- [ ] Commands, firmware, attached media, and network data are treated as untrusted.
- [ ] Tests cover timeouts, absent hardware/drivers, and malformed input where applicable.
- [ ] Build inputs are pinned and checksummed; generated/private material is absent.
- [ ] Applicable VM or physical-hardware results are attached without stable identifiers.
- [ ] Commits include a DCO `Signed-off-by` trailer.

## Compatibility

State report/profile/API compatibility and the required Semantic Version impact.
